title: The Plan changes after a pass, and the next checkpoint shows how

steps.action: Add a Task and move another after a checkpoint passes.
steps.expected_result: The Plan takes the change as an ordinary Task edit.

steps.action: Report the next checkpoint after the Plan changed.
steps.expected_result: It lists what was added and moved since the pass, against what was to come then.

expected_result: Each step behaves as its acceptance criterion says.
